data.description: The Gruesome Eminence is a post-Moon Lord magic weapon, and the exhumed form of the Ghastly Visage. When used, it summons a spirit congregation that loosely follows the cursor and occasionally moves around randomly on its own. The congregation occasionally releases smaller spirits as time passes, which...

<p>The <b>Gruesome Eminence</b> is a post-<a href="/wiki/Moon_Lord" title="Moon Lord">Moon Lord</a> <a href="/wiki/Magic_weapon" class="mw-redirect" title="Magic weapon">magic weapon</a>, and the <a href="/wiki/Exhumed" class="mw-redirect" title="Exhumed">exhumed</a> form of the <a href="/wiki/Ghastly_Visage" title="Ghastly Visage">Ghastly Visage</a>. When used, it summons a spirit congregation that loosely follows the cursor and occasionally moves around randomly on its own. The congregation occasionally releases smaller spirits as time passes, which are purely visual. These spirits float around and linger for a few seconds before being pulled back into the congregation. After 14 seconds, the spirits accumulate to create a single monstrosity, which is fully controllable by the player. The damage of the spirit congregation gradually builds up from 100% to 185% base damage as it grows to full size.
</p><p>Its best <a href="/wiki/Modifier" class="mw-redirect" title="Modifier">modifier</a> is <b>Mythical</b>.
</p>

<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Notes">Notes</span></h2>
<ul><li>The weapon constantly consumes mana while in use.</li>
<li>The spirit congregation only deals 85% damage to <a href="/wiki/XM-05_Thanatos" class="mw-redirect" title="XM-05 Thanatos">XM-05 Thanatos</a>.</li></ul>
<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Trivia">Trivia</span></h2>
<ul><li>The interior of the spirit congregation contains two different silhouettes resembling <a rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://wikibound.info/wiki/Giygas">Giygas</a> from the game <i><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/en:EarthBound" class="extiw" title="wikipedia:en:EarthBound">EarthBound</a></i>, and another resembling a fetus, also a reference to Giygas.</li>
<li>The Gruesome Eminence itself bears a resemblance to the trinkets dropped by <a class="external text" href="https://darkestdungeon.wiki.gg/wiki/The_Collector_(Darkest_Dungeon)">The Collector</a> from the game <i><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/en:Darkest_Dungeon" class="extiw" title="wikipedia:en:Darkest Dungeon">Darkest Dungeon</a>,</i> particularly Dismas' Head.</li>
<li>While the Gruesome Eminence is in the player's inventory, holding <span class="key" style="display:inline-block; white-space:nowrap;"><a href="/wiki/Game_controls#Shift" title="Game controls"><kbd style="color:black; border: 1px solid rgb(170, 170, 170); box-shadow: 0.1em 0.2em 0.2em rgb(221, 221, 221); border-radius: .2em; background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(238, 238, 238), rgb(249, 249, 249), rgb(238, 238, 238)); background-color: rgb(249, 249, 249); padding: 0.1em 0.4em 0.2em 0.3em; margin-right:2px; font-size:85%; font-family:inherit; font-style:normal;">⇧ Shift</kbd></a></span> on its inventory icon reveals additional <a href="/wiki/Lore" title="Lore">lore</a> in its flavor text written by Calamitas herself:<br><span style="color:#C61B40; font-weight:bold;">'Many will tell you that Yharim fell from grace as his Crusade went on, but that's far from the truth.<br>Sure, he was a good man when he was killing assassins drunk on power, but even as he dethroned dictators, entire kingdoms were leveled alongside.<br>I wish more people could bear witness to this "Polterghast". Maybe then, they would understand the pain he caused for the world.'</span></li></ul>
<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="History">History</span></h2>

<ul><li><b><a href="/wiki/2.2.1" title="2.2.1">2.2.1</a></b>: Now uses the <a href="/wiki/Rarity" title="Rarity Level: 17"><img alt="Rarity Level: 17" src="/images/Rarity_color_17.png?7fba3e" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="110" height="26" data-file-width="110" data-file-height="26"></a> rarity instead of <a href="/wiki/Rarity" title="Rarity Level: 15"><img alt="Rarity Level: 15" src="/images/Rarity_color_15.png?229ff0" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="135" height="20" data-file-width="135" data-file-height="20"></a>.</li></ul>
<ul><li><b><a href="/wiki/2.2.0" title="2.2.0">2.2.0</a></b>: Buffed mana cost from 400 to 30, but mana is now constantly used while channeling the spirit instead of being used once when spawned.</li></ul>
<ul><li><b><a href="/wiki/2.1.0" title="2.1.0">2.1.0</a></b>:
<ul><li>Can no longer damage the player.</li>
<li>Now has its cursor range clamped to within a 1920x1080 screen.</li>
<li>Rewrote flavor tooltip. Flavor tooltip is now collapsed by default, and can be expanded by holding Shift.</li></ul></li></ul>
<ul><li><b><a href="/wiki/2.0.4.001" title="2.0.4.001">2.0.4.001</a></b>:
<ul><li>Nerfed mana cost from 8 to 400.</li>
<li>Increased base velocity and velocity at full charge, and it now grants 11 local immunity frames instead of 12.</li>
<li>Increased sell price from <span data-info="300000" style="white-space:nowrap" title="30 Gold Coins">30 <img alt="Gold Coin" src="https://terraria.wiki.gg/images/Gold_Coin.png?c6fdb6" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="12" height="16" data-file-width="12" data-file-height="16"></span> to <span data-info="480000" style="white-space:nowrap" title="48 Gold Coins">48 <img alt="Gold Coin" src="https://terraria.wiki.gg/images/Gold_Coin.png?c6fdb6" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="12" height="16" data-file-width="12" data-file-height="16"></span>.</li></ul></li></ul>
